subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What aspects of their experience are Yelp reviewers talking about?

judge.implied_focus: The dimensions/aspects of the dining experience discussed in Yelp reviews (aspect-based decomposition of restaurant experience)

per_column.name: food_quality
per_column.rationale: A core experiential aspect of dining; a coherent facet of the implied focus.

per_column.name: ambiance
per_column.rationale: Atmosphere is a distinct, data-inferable experiential facet.

per_column.name: value
per_column.rationale: Price/value is a recognized review aspect.

per_column.name: location
per_column.rationale: A legitimate experiential facet, though less frequently flagged.

per_column.name: cleanliness
per_column.rationale: Hygiene is a distinct experiential facet.

per_column.name: wait_time
per_column.rationale: Timing/waiting is a concrete facet of the experience.

per_column.name: menu_variety
per_column.rationale: Menu breadth is a differentiated aspect distinct from food quality.

per_column.name: primary_aspect
per_column.rationale: Summarizes the dominant aspect(s) per review, tying the facets together into a top-level classification.

judge.rationale: The columns collectively and unambiguously centre on ONE coherent, data-inferable focus: the aspects of the dining experience mentioned in reviews. This directly realises the analytical query. The structure is a well-differentiated set of binary aspect indicators (food quality, service, ambiance, value, location, cleanliness, wait time, menu variety) covering distinct, non-redundant facets at a useful granularity, plus a summarizing primary_aspect column that names the dominant theme(s) per review. This is neither a single restatement nor undifferentiated noise, and the aspects are non-trivially distinct from bare sentiment (label_pos already exists). The implied focus is highly actionable: an analyst can quantify which aspects dominate reviews, cross them with polarity, and prioritize operational improvements. Minor deductions: primary_aspect is noisy/free-text with overlapping and off-topic values ('This is not a restaurant review', 'DMV service and location experience'), and some aspects (cleanliness, location) are rarely flagged, slightly weakening granularity balance.
